source.title: The Radiant Forge
source.description:
So, it seems like it's a bit of a mess over at Tyr's Hand. That's unfortunate, but the bottom line is that I need to get a good look at the workshop where they've been crafting these armaments. Otherwise I won't have any hope of unlocking this metal's secrets.

Just mark the location of this workshop on my map and I'll make my way there after the coast is clear.
source.objective: Enter the Scarlet Enclave and meet Master Craftsman Omarion at the Radiant Forge there.
source.completion:
I've been studying this workspace and I think I have a solid understanding of what the Crusade has been doing here. We should be able to use this material to make a blade of unparalleled quality.

However, this lightforged iron on its own has a fatal flaw that significantly reduces its durability. It'd be perfect if we could use it as part of an alloy, though.

Just to prepare you though, this could get expensive.
